AUTHOR: Lawal
TITLE: MADNet: Marine Animal Detection Network using the YOLO platform
REGION: Limfjord, northern Denmark (Brackish); China (URPC2019-derived UOv2); RUOD mixed/unspecified
SPECIES: Fish classes only as 'fish'/'small fish' (Brackish) and 'fish' (RUOD); other classes are crab, shrimp, jellyfish, starfish, echinus, holothurian, scallop, waterweeds, corals, diver, cuttlefish, turtle
DATA: Public: Brackish (Roboflow version, 14,674 images), UOv2/URPC2019 (Roboflow100, 7,600), RUOD (14,000)
V_EV: Underwater datasets: 'A camera mounted 9 meters below the surface on the Limfjord Bridge in northern Denmark was utilized to obtain the image dataset.'
D2: Brackish 8:1:1 (11,739/1,467/1,468); UOv2 7:2:1 (5,320/1,520/760); RUOD 9,800 train/4,200 valid random + 300-image provided test (blur/color/light)
D_EV: Underwater datasets: 'was randomly divided into train-set, valid-set, and test-set in an 8:1:1 ratio, with 11739, 1467, and 1468 images, respectively.'
R_EV: Conclusions: 'Experiments were conducted on publicly available underwater image datasets, namely brackish, UOv2, and RUOD' (each trained and tested within-dataset)
E_EV: Eq. (11): 'The n is the number of images, while Gi and Pi, respectively, represent the ground-truth count and predicted count for the i-th image.'
ARCH: MADNet (YOLOv5/YOLOv8-based; C3b, SPPFr, C3 modules; anchor-based and anchor-free variants) vs YOLOv5n, YOLOv6n, YOLOv7-tiny, YOLOv8n
METR: P, R, mAP50, params, FLOPs, training time, fps, per-image count MAE, composite performance score
NOTE: INCL borderline: marine-animal detector (crabs, echinoderms, etc.), fish are only 1-2 classes in two of three datasets and no fish-specific results are reported; coded INCL=Y because fish are target classes in in-situ underwater imagery (non-fish exclusion not clearly met) - verifier should check against review scope. V: Brackish camera depth 9 m (V2=Y) -> V_ALL=P; RUOD described with 'haze-like effect, color cast, and light interference' and its test set has 100 blur/100 color/100 light images, but results are not stratified by these subsets (V6=N). D: random image-level splits; Brackish frames come from continuous video, so near-duplicate leakage likely but not discussed -> D_ALL=N. RUOD test set is the dataset-provided 300-image challenge subset (split unit not stated). R: no cross-dataset testing. C: 'other default settings' - no confidence/NMS threshold value reported -> NR. E: per-image count MAE vs annotation counts of the same images, treated as human counts of same footage (Clarification 4 analogy) -> E_ALL=P; a stricter reading (MAE is a detection metric) would give E1=없음, E_ALL=N. MAE combined valid+test sets. NCLASS: 6 (Brackish), 5 (UOv2), 10 (RUOD).
